      public String uploadObject(String folder, String filename, byte[] body, String contentType)
      Upload via the backend (AWS SDK). Avoids browser CORS and custom SigV4 pitfalls on R2.

    • uploadInvoicePdf

      public String uploadInvoicePdf(String filename, byte[] body)
      Caches one Zoho invoice PDF to the "invoices" folder. Deliberately separate from uploadObject(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, byte[], java.lang.String) — that method's folder/extension whitelists are an image-only invariant for admin uploads and must not be loosened to let PDFs through everywhere.

    • listObjects

      public List<S3StorageService.StoredObject> listObjects(String folder, String suffix, int maxKeys)
      List stored objects under a folder (for gallery recovery). Requires R2 token with ListBucket permission.
